title: Magikarp to Gyarados evolution
narration: Magikarp is getting ready for something big.
Magikarp evolved into Gyarados! But it is not over yet.
Gyarados reacts to its Mega Stone. Mega Evolution!
Mega Gyarados, a Water and Dark type! Who is your favourite Water-type Pokemon? Comment below!
Its old Poke Ball suddenly feels a little too small. Awkward.

shots: the creature looks around determined, water and spray float around it, anime style, smooth animation, camera slowly pushes in
the creature appears in a burst of white light and looks around proudly, water and spray swirl around it, anime style, smooth animation
the creature roars with overwhelming power, dark shadows and rainbow energy explode around it, epic low angle camera, anime style, dynamic motion
